name: Riverside Youth Council
org: City of Riverside Parks, Recreation and Community Services
what_you_do: Join a teen leadership group the city started in 2004. You speak up on policies that affect youth and help pick the city's 25 Most Remarkable Teens.
who_can_apply: The city page does not list all the rules. A 2019 city news release says members come from Riverside Unified and Alvord Unified schools. Ask the city before you apply.
pay_detail: The program page does not list pay.
duration: School year, starting in August. Meeting times are not listed.
deadline_text: The city takes forms only from February 1 through May 1. Membership starts in August of the next school year. The 2027 form is not posted as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: This group has its own form, not the regular city board form. Call the City Clerk at 951-826-5557 or Parks and Recreation at 951-826-2272 and ask for it.
notes: The council gets help from the Johnny Martin Sotelo Youth Opportunity Center and Parks and Recreation. The city has no page just for this group, so call with your questions.
